## Deterministic and data boundaries

- [ ] Financial and feasibility rules remain deterministic; no AI output sets totals, severity, guest counts, or approval state.
- [ ] Protected categories, minimums, and explicit-approval requirements are preserved.
- [ ] New behavior validates untrusted data at its boundary and has tests where practical.
- [ ] Documentation and `docs/FEATURE_STATUS.md` are updated if behavior or scope changed.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, `.env` contents, provider keys, or real guest/planning data are included.
- [ ] No new browser-to-provider call bypasses the server boundary.
- [ ] No unnecessary dependency, backend service, or database was added.
- [ ] Screenshots use the labelled sample workspace or synthetic data.
